build_task_template: build a PHYRE task template that creates a dynamic ball and static obstacle balls in a scene
create_dynamic_ball: create a dynamic ball object at a random center position near the top of the scene
add_static_balls: add static ball obstacles arranged in a random walk pattern across the scene
update_task_goal: update the task goal to require the dynamic ball touching the bottom wall
define_spatial_relationship: define a spatial relationship using C.SpatialRelationship.TOUCHING between two bodies in the scene
